'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Cole Lepine LS Kashyyyk (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk (V)|VB5-L-kashyyyk-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' How many Canadians does it take to play Sonn V Wookiees?
* '''Username:''' clepine
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
